paragraphs.text: The following Kamigawan characters are only mentioned in flavor text or on legendary creature cards, appear as minor characters in the storyline , or are otherwise not notable enough to receive their own article.

Asuga of the Order of Hanami is an orochi ninja in the Order of Jukai . She has yellow eyes, wears ninja garb, and is bonded to a kami that uses vines to bind others. The kami appears as little steam shapes that float around her, disappearing and reappearing in small puffs. Her cell was killed in a fight after the Saiba Futurists gave them false information as a distraction to capture a kami. She traveled with Asuga and Rei to recover the kami.
Doku is an orochi fighter. A champion of the Towashi Undercity fighting pits and a former Yoruma Reckoner . He is angular and muscular with a deep voice. He wears advanced armor.
Itazura is a kami . Its name is Japanese for "prank" or "mischief".
Kenta is an Okiba Reckoner nezumi ninja. He was a childhood friend of Rei.
Itachi is a gray nezumi . He is the owner of Itachi's, a noodle bar in the Towashi Undercity. He is known to trade for information.
Junichiro is a human samurai . A mountain of a man, he wears a specialized mask and is covered in intricate tattoos binding kami to him. He is a former Imperial who joined the Hyozan Reckoners .
Nishi is an Imperial kitsune . She has five tails and wears a robe.

Rei is an Asari human samurai . They are tall, stocky, and use they/them pronouns. They carry an oversized blaster and a katana. They grew up in the Towashi Undercity . When Saiba Futurists pulled a kami from a merge, planning to weaponize it, they traveled with Asuga and Touma to recover it.

Touma is an Imperial human samurai. He is the primary non-player character protagonist of Kamigawa: A Visual Novel . He comes from a rich family. He carries a naginata, katana, and tanto. When Saiba Futurists pulled a kami from a merge, planning to weaponize it, he traveled with Asuga and Rei to recover it.

Yume is a human druid member of the Living Historians . After the opening of the Omenpaths , she began collecting stories from other planes. She has performed at a halftime show of a battle in Valor's Reach stadium on Kylem .
The following Kamigawan characters are only mentioned in flavor text or appear as minor characters in the storyline.
